### 2026-10-07 – I'm halfway done with the PCB design.

**1.67h**

I'm halfway done with the PCB design.

Around 4:50pm I started transferring my project files to my mom's ChromeOS via GitHub. I spent almost 30 minutes setting up KiCad and encountering issues with the Flathub config (I used the .flatpakref file in the end).

![Screenshot 2026-10-07 5.23.46 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/wjmq9nV2rIfjzLCoTWm8ngcObr4enEZP/a59c8999e3f2a17195075139335710961fbbf5304d8a660eddec6d678685246c.png)

Then I got to work. I corrected a typo in the schematics editor (GPIO3 vs. GPI03) and finally started to route the circuits. However, this was like a puzzle. I had to rearrange the parts and unroute them THREE times (the  number after two!)  only to find out that the final routing was unoptimized and there was a malformed courtyard.

![Screenshot 2026-10-07 6.06.04 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/wjmq9nV2rIfjzLCoTWm8ngcObr4enEZP/f264c2f538c75fc39d0e0dc228744162cdc1b687be9d36de186397332843e99a.png)

![Screenshot 2026-10-07 6.13.58 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/wjmq9nV2rIfjzLCoTWm8ngcObr4enEZP/e35ca90f67d9f9dda3ce29e1a18f9fe11ba0dbd74038a9c8e9ea0e4dee5721c4.png)

Now, I'm no hardware expert (weeeeell I peeked inside some tech like my Xbox One S), but this DOES look like junk stuffed in a closet. So, next time I'll reshape the edges and see if I can fix it. And look for tutorials about courtyards, of course.

Anyway, I called it a day at exactly 6:20pm.

### 2026-10-09 – I've made a severe, continuous *Lapse* of my judgement and I don't expect to win back so many wasted minutes...

**1.23h**

I've made a severe, continuous *Lapse* of my judgement and I don't expect to win back so many wasted minutes...

All right,  here's the thing: the errors I recorded last session were not significant. And if I had carefully read the guide, I wouldn't have wasted thirty minutes on trying to fix it myself (sorry, reviewers).

![Screenshot 2026-10-09 9.04.24 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/wjmq9nV2rIfjzLCoTWm8ngcObr4enEZP/4b766d0071763f656a7a1f47ea79b1669786187ec16e1b1afb5a8e53d6f28140.png)

On the other hand, I reshaped the edge cuts for the PCB and used both front and back copper routers for the connections, following the guide as reference. Then, I added a ground pour (a filled area/net). Finally, I started browsing for images to convert them to symbols for my Starbie.

![Screenshot 2026-10-09 9.07.15 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/wjmq9nV2rIfjzLCoTWm8ngcObr4enEZP/9fc562f5b5f16cf3589b1f82fd809c46dc01ace840151e3a8016f2605b25f57e.png)

Today I learned to avoid derailing from instructions, especially when I don't know what I'm doing, and to understand in advance what I'm supposed to do with things like these. (I want to shout out to this guy for making me actually follow the guide!)

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/wjmq9nV2rIfjzLCoTWm8ngcObr4enEZP/6ff0f320de117489f0c34644f814148019b999b0d0c056d2aafac5e3828b4b9b.png)
